parts.text: A solid metal sphere has a volume of 31 cm 3 .

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The mass of the metal sphere is 87 g. Calculate the density of the metal. State the unit. density = .................................. unit ............... [3]

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
add water to the measuring cylinder AND measure the volume (of water)
measure (water) volume (in the measuring cylinder) after sphere is added
Any one from:
•
volume (of sphere) = difference in (water) volume
•
V= V2-V1
Fill a (eureka) can to the top with water AND add sphere
collect and measure displaced water (in a measuring cylinder)
volume of displaced water = volume (of sphere)
